verdict.rationale: Sierra covers parts of an ongoing conversation-QA loop. Insights tracks CSAT and resolution metrics and shows the reasoning behind each agent action. Explorer analyzes thousands of real conversations and sends weekly briefings on emerging issues, with one-click investigation of trends. Fixes can flow back through Ghostwriter prompt edits, Agent Checks/Simulations, and experiments. However, no evidence shows explicit per-conversation QA scoring of sampled conversations, automatic flagging of individual failed conversations, or a structured reviewer workflow tying flagged items to agent changes. Missing for 10: scored conversation sampling/QA scorecards, per-conversation failure flagging, a documented review-to-fix loop, independent or hands-on corroboration.
